title: Closures capture variables
hints: Every function in the slice returns the same result. A closure captures the variable itself, not the value it had when the closure was created.
All the closures share the single factor variable declared before the loop, so they all see its final value.
Use the loop's own variable inside the closure: for _, f := range factors { fns = append(fns, func(x int) int { return x * f }) }. Since Go 1.22, each iteration gets a fresh f.
